idea-plugin.name: Zigote
idea-plugin.description:
Rider support for the Zigote UI framework.
  • Colour swatches in the gutter for new Color(0xFF2196F3), Color.FromHex, Color.Rgb and Color.Rgba, with the platform colour picker on click.
  • Preview from the editor — a ▶ in the gutter next to every widget the running app can show, and Preview Zigote Widget (Alt+Shift+P) for the one at the caret. Both swap a running app in place instead of restarting it.
  • A Zigote tool window: the running app's frame — live and interactive (click, drag, scroll and type on the picture), streamed at animation rate — plus its widget tree and accessibility tree, with pickers for project, widget, device size, theme and locale, none of which restart the app.
  • Preview properties: a widget's defaulted constructor or factory parameters become controls under the picture, so the same page can be looked at empty, full, or with a title long enough to wrap, without editing it.
  • Run on Device — deploy to the attached phone or emulator and keep editing: saving a Build() re-runs it in the running app instead of reinstalling. Same thing zigote device run does from a terminal.
  • [Preview] — annotate a widget or page and it gets a name, a group, and the device size and theme it is meant to be looked at in.
Both halves live in the framework (Zigote.UI.Host.WidgetPreview and InspectServer) and are driven by environment variables and a loopback socket, so they work without this plugin too.
